Six Indian Tourists Missing in Nepal After Heavy Snowfall

Six Indian tourists have gone missing during a trek to Shey-Phoksundo Lake in Nepal, the country's deepest lake, following heavy snowfall. Rescue efforts are underway for the stranded individuals.
